uiState.noVersion: The interface state has no version.
uiState.notJson: The interface state is not JSON.
uiState.tooLarge: The interface state is too large.

sites.tailnetBlocked: Tailscale is off or this address is not in your tailnet; not opened over plain http.
sites.badgeTailnetTitle: Plain http (unencrypted). Loaded only while Tailscale is on and this address is in your tailnet; the device that runs this address inside the tailnet can see the traffic.
sites.badgeLocalTitle: Plain http (unencrypted); the address is this computer itself.
sites.urlCredentials: the address cannot contain a user name or password.
sites.urlHttpNeedsIp: http:// is accepted only for Tailscale/local addresses written as an IP address (e.g. http://100.x.y.z:9119); a domain name needs https://.
sites.urlHttpNotPrivate: http:// is accepted only for Tailscale and local addresses ({cidrs}); this address needs https://.
sites.urlScheme: the address must start with https:// (http:// also works for a Tailscale/local IP address, e.g. http://100.x.y.z:9119).
sites.nameTooLong: {title}…: the name can be at most {max} characters.
sites.duplicateId: {title}: two sites have the same id.

client.transportUnchecked: Could not check whether the connection is secure.
